body:
Built real SSH client transport (internal/sshconn, golang.org/x/crypto/ssh), self-contained Ed25519 key generation (internal/sshkey, private key never leaves device), and a one-time enrollment listener (cmd/pitviper-enroll) so pairing a new device needs zero manual key copy-paste. Verified live end to end. Fixed a real -ssh-insecure bug found during testing. Android APK packaging (NDK cross-compile + SDLActivity) not started -- go-sdl2 only ships prebuilt android libs for 32-bit arm, not arm64. Commit fb77a85.

⚓ ☃
title: SSH client mode + on-device key gen + one-time enrollment (Android build prep)
